description: Read exact unreduced BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, TRX, BNB, DOGE, TON, LINK, HYPE, WBTC, ADA, NEAR, XLM, BCH, LTC, UNI, AVAX, SUI, HBAR, WLD, WLFI, LIT, MNT, SHIB, QNT, ENA, MORPHO, AAVE, ONDO, DOT, ZRO, PEPE, SKY, ARB, FF, POL, APT, CRV, ZAMA, SENT, ETHFI, PENDLE, ENS, FET, LDO, EIGEN, SPX, EDGE, IMX, AXS, BAT, GRT, SYRUP, FLOKI, COMP, SAND, APE, PROM, ALT, GALA, NIL or ERA observations with decimal strings, original source clocks, revision, finality and gaps. End is exclusive. Metric-specific interval and retained-publication restrictions apply. No new observation is acquired. Without an account it serves metrics whose plan is free (get_asset_metrics shows the plan of each row) at 24h, 1w, 1M or 1Y; anything else answers with the plan it needs and the free metrics closest to it.
